summary: 2026-09-14 Firestore/Storage rules audit: UID-based isolation, immutable source metadata, server-owned AI state and deletion locks are enforced. No cross-account bypass found in inspected rules and emulator regressions. Score applies to rules only, not IAM, App Check or overall production readiness.

findings.issue: Per-member file and record bounds exist, but an authenticated account can create arbitrarily many members and accumulate files. Per-account aggregate storage and creation-rate controls are absent.
findings.recommendation: Add account-level resource accounting and monitored abuse controls before public launch; preserve the separately configured unlimited daily/monthly AI policy.
